correctness.rationale: Exact normal and opposite-support enumeration makes the primal four-facet LP necessary and sufficient. Three nonnegative dual weights yield s>=1+(1-pq)/(1+p) for ordered ratios; z=(s-1,1-q) has slacks 0,0,(1-q^2)/q,0, proving sufficiency. Positivity of active dual weights implies unique center unless pq=1, when the body is a parallelogram with unique symmetry center. Symbolic formulas and 64 independent Fraction-based LP vertex enumerations checked.

originality.rationale: The point-inversion optimum and every optimizing quadrilateral center are computed exactly. Reviewed primary literature provides generalized chirality and rounding results but no all-quadrilateral evaluation; related accessible records address other observables or other polygon families. residual_risks: Exact formulas in unindexed/classical Minkowski-asymmetry papers may predate the search and remain unverified.
Full manuscripts of several adjacent mathematical records were not read; comparisons for those were limited to the public summaries, with their distinct observables stated.
Searches and title/abstract absence do not establish world-first publication; an independent bibliographic review is still needed.
